issue_context.title: [FG:InPlacePodVerticalScaling] Implement version skew handling for in-place pod resize
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

This is a tracking bug to implement two changes to better handle version skew as documented in https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/1287-in-place-update-pod-resources#version-skew-strategy
1. kubelet: When feature-gate is disabled, if kubelet sees a Proposed resize, it rejects the resize as Infeasible.
2. scheduler: If PodStatus.Resize field is not empty, scheduler uses max(ResourcesAllocated, Requests) even if the feature-gate is disabled.


### Why is this needed?

This is needed to gracefully handle component version skews that can occur during upgrades.

The version skew strategy has been updated from the original design:

https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-node/1287-in-place-update-pod-resources/README.md#version-skew-strategy
I'm interested in taking this up. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/125394 seems to be related to how we handle the version skew policy, how do we go about that?
The version skew strategy is based on the resources field, not the resize policy, so I think https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/125394 is not tied to this, unless I'm missing something?
Oh, you were referring to the side note about version skew? I think that's out of date, and can be ignored.

review_comments: Why are we changing these resource size in tests?🤔️

According to the chapter `Version Skew Strategy` of the KEP-1287, when  kube-scheduler computes the pod resource requests,  it should use max(AllocatedResources, Requests) if PodStatus.Resize != "".

In this test case, the PodStatus.Resize is equal to Infeasible and the AllocatedResources is less than Requests, so the expected result is Requests. I'm not sure that this change is reasonable when the PodStatus.Resize is equal to Infeasible. If I misunderstood, please correct me. Thanks.

FYI:

- https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-node/1287-in-place-update-pod-resources#version-skew-strategy
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/apis/core/types.go#L2576
